name: Hexyl butyrate

pubchem.title: Hexyl butyrate
pubchem.description: Hexyl butyrate is a fatty acid ester obtained by the formal condensation of hexanol with butyric acid. It has a role as an animal metabolite. It is functionally related to a butyric acid and a hexan-1-ol.
